title: The interrupted story
vo: Lo cuma pengen cerita soal hari yang berat. Kok obrolannya malah jadi daftar solusi?
purpose: Show story colliding with unsolicited solution cards.

title: Room to be heard
vo: Kadang, yang lo butuhin saat itu cuma ruang buat didengar dulu.
purpose: Offer the value early: open room for the speaker.

title: After work
vo: Misalnya, lo pulang bilang: gua capek, tadi kerjaan gua dikritik lagi.
purpose: Ground the fictional account in a doorway, bag and marked work sheet.

title: The story stops
vo: Dia jawab: ya udah, cari kerja lain aja. Lalu cerita lo berhenti.
purpose: Let the outgoing ribbon meet a blocking response, then stop.

title: An unfinished account
vo: Sarannya mungkin masuk akal. Tapi lo belum sempat menjelaskan bagian yang berat.
purpose: Keep unfinished speech visible beside a plausible solution.
beats: Speaker still has more to say

title: Suspend the verdict
vo: Satu respons belum cukup buat menyimpulkan dia nggak peduli. Mungkin dia ingin membantu.
purpose: Make the listener and an uncertain question the focus; avoid motive diagnosis.

title: Intention and experience
vo: Niat membantu dan merasa dipahami belum tentu ketemu dalam respons yang sama.
purpose: Separate the offered solution from the receiving speech space.

title: Listening and checking
vo: Mendengarkan aktif berarti berusaha memahami cerita, lalu mengecek apakah tangkapan kita sudah tepat.
purpose: Show a return path checking a story against the speaker.

title: Let the story unfold
vo: Coba tahan saran sebentar. Kasih ruang sampai dia selesai menjelaskan bagian yang berat.
purpose: Move advice aside as three parts of the story unfold.
beats: Final part appears; advice waits aside

title: Check the meaning
vo: Lo bisa bilang: jadi, lo kecewa karena usaha lo tadi kayak nggak kelihatan?
purpose: Turn an inferred feeling into a question returned to the speaker.

title: Accept correction
vo: Kalau dia mengoreksi, ikuti koreksinya. Jangan buru-buru mempertahankan tebakan lo.
purpose: Replace the tentative listening path with the corrected route.

title: Offer a choice
vo: Gua dengerin dulu, atau lo pengen kita cari jalan keluar bareng?
purpose: Open two support options on a fork, leaving the speaker agency.

title: Needs may change
vo: Pertanyaan ini memberi pilihan. Jawabannya juga bisa berubah selama obrolan.
purpose: Move a shared marker between options without ranking either.

title: State a need
vo: Kalau lo yang cerita, bilang: gua mau didengerin dulu. Nanti kita pikirin langkahnya.
purpose: Give the original speaker a clear request in their own space.

title: Advice in shared space
vo: Saran tetap punya tempat, ketika itu yang dibutuhkan. Mendengar dulu membantu lo menyesuaikannya.
purpose: Bring the solution note back onto a shared table after listening.
beats: Solution note lands on shared table

title: Return to the opening
vo: Sebelum menyusun jawaban, coba cari tahu: sekarang, bantuan seperti apa yang dia butuhkan?
purpose: End with a large shared conversation space and deliberate quiet hold.
